The admin for this site has one rule: a full page reload should never be necessary while editing.

Why not an SPA#

An SPA would duplicate the validation, the routing and the templates. Every form still works without JavaScript1, which matters at 2am.

1

Progressive enhancement here means the plain form posts and redirects; htmx only intercepts when present.

Autosave meets revisions#

Autosave fires on keyup changed delay:800ms.

tip

Explicit saves (⌘S) always create a new revision. Only autosaves coalesce.
